encounters.requirements:
Clear: defeat all opponents within 1m 45s.
Star Challenge: finish within 1m 10s.
encounters.mechanics: Radiant Cocoon reduces damage, incoming healing, and CRIT Rate. Heal the affected character to full HP to escape and receive a temporary damage and CRIT buff. The Moonfly can alternate between Dendro and Pyro attacks.

encounters.name: Arcanum Challenge 1 · Consecrated beasts
encounters.resistances:
Consecrated Fanged Beast: Consecrated Enhance: Physical, Pyro, Hydro, Electro, Cryo, Anemo, Geo 40%; Dendro 70%.
Consecrated Scorpion: Consecrated Enhance: Physical, Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 40%; Electro 70%.
Consecrated Horned Crocodile: Consecrated Enhance: Physical, Pyro, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 40%; Hydro 70%.
Consecrated Red Vulture: Consecrated Enhance: Physical, Hydro, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 40%; Pyro 70%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: survive the 6m initial countdown with at least one character standing; each defeat removes 30s.
Star Challenge: defeat 10 opponents.
Active enemies: 1.
encounters.mechanics: Destroy matching-element Energy Blocks, absorb their power, then hit the corresponding Consecrated Beast to paralyze it. Its enhanced resistance falls outside the base resistance values.
encounters.stageEffects: Geo bursts periodically damage the active character.

encounters.name: Arcanum Challenge 2 · Potapo’s Solidarity
encounters.resistances: Potapo's Solidarity: Secret Shadow's Re-Emergence: Cryo 50%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: defeat all opponents within 2m 5s.
Star Challenge: finish within 1m 25s.
encounters.mechanics: This special Biting-Cold Wayob encounter creates a Protection Spirit and a Hostile Spirit. Healing party members also heals the Protection Spirit; fully restoring it triggers an attack on the Hostile Spirit. Greater healing increases the spirit’s attack damage.
